description: Close M2 milestone: update backlog B-032/B-033, add ask_user question handling to mo attach via smart input routing

tasks.title: Add question event formatting to event-formatter
tasks.description: Add question_asked and question_answered to EVENT_CONFIGS in event-formatter.ts so mo attach displays formatted output for these events.
acceptanceCriteria: question_asked event displays formatted line with issue ID and question text
question_answered event displays formatted confirmation line
tasks.notes: Add questionId and question fields to EventData interface. Use '??' symbol and chalk.yellow for question_asked, '✓' and chalk.green for question_answered.

tasks.title: Add QUESTION_MODE state and question_asked/question_answered handling to mo attach
tasks.description: Extend attach.ts to track QUESTION_MODE alongside GATE_MODE. On question_asked, enter QUESTION_MODE storing questionId. On question_answered for current questionId, return to IDLE. On agent_started/agent_completed, clear QUESTION_MODE.
acceptanceCriteria: question_asked event transitions to QUESTION_MODE with prompt showing the question
question_answered event for current questionId returns to IDLE
tasks.notes: Use single InteractionState type variable instead of pausedIssue, containing three states: IDLE, GATE_MODE, QUESTION_MODE. Reference design.md D1 decision. State transitions: agent_paused → GATE_MODE, question_asked → QUESTION_MODE, agent_started/agent_completed/question_answered → IDLE.

tasks.title: Route user input in QUESTION_MODE to questions reply API
tasks.description: In the readline on('line') handler, check if in QUESTION_MODE and route input to POST /questions/:id/reply instead of POST /messages. Display error on 409/410 and return to IDLE.
acceptanceCriteria: User input in QUESTION_MODE sends answer to /api/questions/<questionId>/reply
Successful reply clears QUESTION_MODE and returns to IDLE
API error (409/410) displays error message and returns to IDLE
User input in IDLE displays 'No paused agent or pending question'
tasks.notes: Refactor the readline handler to check InteractionState.type: QUESTION_MODE first (route to /questions/:id/reply), then GATE_MODE (route to /issues/:number/messages), then IDLE (show 'No paused agent or pending question'). Use switch statement or if-else chain based on state.type.

acceptanceCriteria: B-032 status shows completed with reference to implementation
B-033 status shows completed with reference to mo attach solution
tasks.notes: B-032 marked completed (SSE is implemented protocol). B-033 marked completed (resolved via mo attach unified interaction with QUESTION_MODE routing).
